keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
RICACL used to be in the business of agriculture goods such as Rice Milling, Rice Sorting, Dal Milling, Dal Processing and Agriculture Products. Currently, the company is doing trading of Imported Coal. It is based at Raipur, Chhattisgarh, and its operations are spread across India. Company's product comprises coal sourced from Indonesia, South Africa, Australia, and India. It supplies products to the customers in various sectors; Power, Steel, Rolling and other industries, through Road transportation and Railways
